state:
**Goal `program-enumeration`: Stages 2 and 3 are on disk, and Stage 4, the proofs, is what is left.** `rule:programs/constructors` is `shipped`, guarded by three conformance cases and `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs`.

`Core\Program::constructors<T, C>()` has its row and cards in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/program.rs`. Stage 3 asked the handoff to say so if `CoreTy` needed a variant, and it did: `CoreTy::WrittenReturning("C", &T)`. The row names `T` nowhere else, so plain `Written("C")` made the call take one type argument. The expansion is `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:@expand_constructors`, recorded as `ExprInfo::ProgramConstructors`. `nvs-ir` lowers each `make` as a first-class-callable thunk whose `ThunkTarget::Build` body writes the `new` (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/closure.rs:@build_thunk_body`). The refusals are `E0838` (`C` is not a `callable(...)` returning `T`) and `E0839` (a listed class's constructor does not fit, with the reason as a note). The `nvs-lsp` jump already worked on both type arguments, and its test is in place.

A shape type now accepts a keyword as a field name (`{class: string}`), as the object literal already did. The row's `class` field needed it.

The `Core\Program` perf figures that the edit to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/program.rs` made stale have been measured again.

next.title: the feature proofs and the reference

items.text: **`constructors`' `about.md` and three examples** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): a handler picked by name and built with a dependency, a plugin list built lazily, and a command table printed without building anything. Copy the shape of `docs/examples/core/Program/implementingWith/about.md:1`, and write each comment to `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*. `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Program::constructors'` names what is owed and where.

**The attack and the bench**: `tests/hostile/core/Program/constructors/` (a request tries to build a class whose constructor is private, then one outside `T`, and neither compiles), shaped like `tests/hostile/core/Program/implementing/01-a-constructor-that-throws-halfway.nvs:1`. Then `benches/members/core/Program/constructors.nvs` (build the list and call one `make`), shaped like `benches/members/core/Program/implementing.nvs:1`. Then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Program'`.

**`implementing` and `implementingWith` grow**: one new example in each directory selects by an abstract base class, and each `about.md` is rewritten whole to say "an interface or a class" (`docs/examples/core/Program/implementing/about.md:1`).

**The reference**: rewrite `docs/reference/core/Program.md:1` for the class selector and `constructors`, then run `bun nv reference` to regenerate `docs/novis.md`. Finish with `bun nv proofs --comments docs/examples/core/Program tests/hostile/core/Program/constructors benches/members/core/Program/constructors.nvs` and `bun nv proofs --gate`.

backlog: A variadic constructor gets an empty tail through `make`: `C`'s parameters fill only the fixed parameters (`crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:@constructor_fitting`'s doc). Passing a tail would need `C` to name one, and a `callable(...)` type cannot.
`docs/reference/core/Program.md` and `data/reference/core/Program.json` still describe "every class implementing an interface". Stage 4's last item rewrites them.
